description: Create and connect calendars, add, change and delete events, prepare replies to invitations and manage the job search schedule. Events are written to the member's own calendars; no invitations are sent. Actions: create_local, connect_caldav, import_ics, sync, choose_calendar, create_event, update_event, delete_event, hide_interview_event, prepare_rsvp, import_invitation, disconnect, update_schedule, generate_schedule, approve_schedule, discard_schedule. Call with action "help" for each action's fields.

calendar_event_id.description: A calendar event's id from get_calendar view (events[].id).

key.description: The item's key as the matching list answered it.

mail_message_id.description: A received message's id: its Mailbox id (i-…) or the same id without "i-" (a calendar event's or RSVP draft's mailMessageId); either works.

params.description: Fields for the action. Call with action "help" to list each action's fields.

name: manage_calendar
title: Manage the calendar
